description:
LONG BEACH CRUISER 500W ELECTRIC BIKE
In 2014, Big Cat introduced an Uni-Sex Step thru electric beach cruiser bicycle; The Long Beach Cruiser was Designed to Reflect Vincent`s Mother Gloria need`s and want`s to assist her again after Health Ailments easily regaining Mobility with Big Cat Electric Bike! Since then, the Long Beach Cruiser has been one of the most popular electric bikes in the USA. The new 2023 release of this popular electric bike is a Premium offering maintaining a sleek and stylish look that riders love. The LBC electric bicycle is equipped with a 48V 13Ah Removable lithium-ion battery, while still maintaining its strong and efficient 500W geared rear hub motor. On this beach cruiser, you'll be sure to get an average of 30-60 miles on a single charge! If it's speed you're after, we have that covered! These electric bicycles can reach speeds of up to 20 mph at the twist of a throttle, allowing you to get to your destination faster without breaking a sweat! Ride confidently with the upgraded 2.3" wheel and tire combo which gives riders a sturdier feel and overall control of the bicycle. One of the most important features on the LBC is the Pedal Assist function. This latest edition beach cruiser e-bike still offers both pedal assist and throttle functions, however, the new pedal assist function gives riders the ability to choose between 1-5 levels of pedal assist which control the amount or propulsion you get from the motor. Set it to the highest level for effortless riding, or if you're seeking a workout and want to save some of your battery's life, set the bike to a lower setting. Equipped with a Shimano 7 speed derailleur, getting up hills is much easier and when you’re coming downhill, don’t worry, The Big Cat Mini Cat features Tektro 180mm Front & Rear Mechanical Disc Brakes with motor cut off switch for a much safer stop. All-Big Cat Long Beach Cruiser models are equipped with a standard King Meter KM-529 LCD Display with intergrated wiring inside frame using simple plug and play design weatherproofing All Electronics
